name: Download scan screenshot
description: Download the PNG screenshot of a finished urlscan.io scan as a file of the playbook run. The file can be downloaded from the playbook run and may show victim data. Fails when urlscan.io did not store the screenshot.

screenshot_path.description: Path of the PNG, relative to the playbook run storage: urlscan/<uuid>.png

screenshot_url.description: Link to the PNG on urlscan.io

size.description: Size of the PNG in bytes
